name: Nomdal Connect for Shopify
short_description: Connect your Shopify store to your Nomdal AI Employee — sync customers and orders securely via webhooks.
description:
Nomdal Connect for Shopify links your store to your Nomdal platform through a secure, scoped API key, so your AI Employee always has your customers and orders in view.

Features:
- Syncs new orders to Nomdal (find-or-create customer plus order line items, de-duplicated).
- Syncs customers to Nomdal.
- Verifies Shopify webhooks with HMAC-SHA256.
- Reports in with a heartbeat so you can see when the store last connected.
- Secure by default: scoped Bearer API key plus optional HMAC-SHA256 request signing to Nomdal.

Requirements: a Shopify custom app with Admin API access, PHP 7.4+, and a webhook receiver URL pointing at webhook.php.
